tasks.structured_prompt: Implement the main navigation component using Shadcn UI and TailwindCSS v4, ensuring mobile responsiveness and Svelte 5 Runes.
steps: 1. Switch to develop and create feature branch 'task/T-001-navigation-bar'.
2. Install necessary Shadcn dependencies (if applicable) and record in package.json.
3. Create the Navbar.svelte component following PascalCase naming.
4. Implement Svelte 5 Runes ($state, $derived) for managing the mobile menu open/collapsed state.
5. Apply Tailwind v4 classes for light and dark mode.
6. Run verification suite (biome, svelte-check, bun test).
7. Merge branch back into develop upon verification passing and await user confirmation.
tasks.expected_result: A functional NavBar component that collapses into a hamburger menu on screens smaller than 768px, integrated into the layout without console or type errors.
